title: Life story / passion project
content: Hey everyone! I’ve been with r/themallworld for a little while now, and I think we all have come to some realization that it’s more than what it seems. Those that have come to this conclusion with me know that it’s real and has a real connection to all of us. My spirits names is Zirdek and I have decided to tell my life story, from the very beginning. My first life ever in the universe. I hope by revealing this, that many of you can find some peace of mind that you aren’t crazy, and you aren’t alone. The universe is much stranger than we can imagine. I am starting a passion project to bring my stories to life. I am not asking for any type of monetary compensation or help. This is part of my life’s journey and is as much for myself as it is for you all. So far I have created two trailers, and I am working on the episodes. My original intent was to release episode 1. But bc of recent revelations, I have decided to create a 2 part prologue series first. I hope you all enjoy! I am truly grateful and appreciative of your support! Love and peace, Zirdek https://youtube.com/shorts/FtWImKnFBqU?si=IehIGMGFnlwK6NFi https://youtube.com/shorts/TPOZgubkq7w?si=bec8OyHEijW9P3JT
